summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a definitive agreement to acquire a land package and associated water rights near its Springer mine in Nevada from a private seller. Consideration totals US$8.0 million, comprising US$3.5 million cash (including US$0.1 million non-refundable deposit) and US$4.5 million in common shares valued based on the 10-day VWAP. The acquisition more than doubles existing water rights and provides a logistics hub with highway and rail access. Conditions include TSXV approval and water rights transfer; closing expected early 2027. No finder's fees; CEO Christian Kargl-Simard commented positively. Watch for regulatory approvals and share issuance terms.
